messages:
sam: Noticing big gaps in Datadog for inference-prod — dashboards stopped updating ~4m ago, traces are empty, and the error-rate anomaly alert is firing but graphs show flat lines. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: @oncall assigned to pradeep. Incident created INC-1977123456. Severity: P2. Tags: observability, datadog, ingestion.

pradeep: I'm on it. Quick check: are service-level metrics (request success/codes) still present in CloudWatch/Prometheus? If yes, we'll use them to verify customer impact and mute noisy DD alerts.

leah: CloudWatch logs are coming through; Prometheus scrape targets look fine but remote_write to Datadog is the path that's failing. No increase in 5xx yet. I'm going to disable the Datadog exporter on a copy of the collector and flip remote_write to our internal Pushgateway so dashboards remain functional.

sam: Good plan. Adding ops steps to make sure we don't confuse auto-scaling: please hold any horizontal autoscale policies tied to Datadog-derived metrics.

infra-eng: Holding autoscale for inference-api group now. Manual policy applied.

pradeep: Steps I'm running now (posting commands):

```bash
# stop datadog remote_write on the OTEL collector (dry-run)
kubectl -n observability patch deployment otel-collector --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args/1","value":"--metrics-addr=127.0.0.1:9090"}]'

# enable prometheus pushgateway forwarding (temporary)
kubectl -n observability exec -it deploy/otel-collector -- /bin/sh -c 'otelcol --config /etc/otel/config-pushgateway.yaml &'

# create short-lived prometheus dashboard in Grafana pointing at pushgateway
# (UI step)
```

leah: I'm muting the noisy Datadog alerts for inference-api and marking them as suppressed in the alerting runbook. Added a note to avoid on-call escalations while we have a vendor blind spot.

sam: Support, can you draft a brief status page message? We should call out: third-party ingestion delay, UI metrics/traces delayed, core inference operational.

support-lead: Draft ready, posting to status.redwood: "We are investigating an issue affecting Datadog metric and trace ingestion that may cause delays or missing dashboard data. Core API functionality is operational. We will update every 15 minutes." Posting now.

pradeep: Reached out to Datadog via enterprise channel and opened an escalation. Copied their initial reply below when it arrives. Meanwhile I'm enabling S3 export of raw request logs for any deep-dive needs and bumping trace sampling to capture a small durable subset to S3.

leah: Commands to start S3 export of logs and durable traces (one-off):

```bash
# create export task for CloudWatch logs
aws logs create-export-task --task-name dd-fallback-export-$(date +%s) --log-group-name "/aws/ecs/inference-prod" --from $(date -d '20 minutes ago' +%s)000 --to $(date +%s)000 --destination redwood-debug-logs --destination-prefix dd-fallback

# enable OTEL trace sampler to 0.05 for durable exports to s3 via collector
kubectl -n observability patch configmap otel-config -p '{"data":{"sampler":"probabilistic=0.05"}}'
```

datadog-sre: Hi team, Datadog SRE here. We're investigating higher-than-normal ingestion latency in us-west-2 affecting metrics and APM traces. We see backend queue growth; engineers are restarting a subset of ingestion nodes. ETA 15-30m for tail drain, will update.

sam: Thanks for the update. We'll keep Prometheus/Grafana fallback active and mute DD noise until we see normal ingestion.

infra-eng: Quick note: we had a canary deployment of a new batcher on one ASG earlier tonight — not seeing any correlation in request rates. Keeping an eye on any DB or queue throttles.

pradeep: For customer impact assessment: using CloudWatch request logs + Prometheus pushgateway we've confirmed no uptick in error-rate or latency at the API layer for affected tenants. Preparing a short internal summary to feed to support and account teams.

support-lead: Sending the customer message to key accounts: "We observed an external observability vendor ingestion delay that temporarily affected dashboards and traces. Our service remained available and processing requests. We are monitoring and will follow up with a post-mortem"

datadog-sre: Update: ingestion restarts completed, backlog draining. We see metrics and traces returning; queues shrinking. We'll keep monitoring for an hour but ETA to full normalization is ~20m.

leah: I can see spikes of older datapoints coming into DD now and traces backfilling. Rolling back the pushgateway workaround in 10m if no regression.

pradeep: Unmuting DD alerts but keeping a short suppression window to avoid reopening old noisy alerts while historical data arrives. Also creating a Jira for follow-up: RDW-OBS-502 with action items: (1) clearer fallback runbook (prometheus/grafana steps), (2) automated switcher for remote_write targets, (3) alerting thresholds when vendor ingestion lag > X minutes. Assigned to eng-monitoring + eng-infra.

support-lead: Status page updated with resolution note and link to incident ticket.

sam: Thx everyone. Closing active ops for now. Will wait for Datadog final confirmation then we prepare the postmortem. Reopen if ingestion regresses. :white_check_mark:
